question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Hostile
solution:
The correct answer is "**Unfriendly.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **Hostile means unfriendly, aggressive, or antagonistic**.

 
 
• Example: People are very hostile to the idea.
 
 
 
• **Unfriendly is a synonym of hostile, and it means not kind or pleasant**.
 
 
• Example: They exchanged a few unfriendly words and left.
 
 
 
 
 
• Grammatical point: Adjectives like hostile and unfriendly are used to describe a person or thing.
 
• Thus, it can be concluded that the word "unfriendly" is the correct synonym of the word "hostile."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pleasant** (Option 1) means enjoyable or agreeable, which is the opposite of hostile.
 
• **Hospitable** (Option 2) means friendly and welcoming to guests or strangers, which is also the opposite of hostile.
 
• **Empathetic** (Option 3) means understanding and sharing the feelings of others, which is not related to hostility.
